item: 3: repeat the #9743 paired matrix on a quiet host

protocol.regime: quiet host: CI happened to be idle, so no runners were paused; each trial waited for 95% idle CPU over three seconds; CI returned partway through, and trials that exceeded 0.25 external busy cores are kept but excluded from the summary
protocol.seed_note: the JSON seed meta format_version was reset to 4 so the #9712 probe could read it; newer probes overwrite it
protocol.summary_scope: pairs where both trials were accepted
